title: morus alba var. indica
intro: Morus alba var. indica, commonly known as White Mulberry, is a deciduous tree native to Asia that belongs to the Moraceae family. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and lowering blood sugar levels. The therapeutic actions of Morus alba var. indica include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antidiabetic effects, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and anthocyanins. The bioactive constituents of Morus alba var. indica also exhibit antimicrobial and anti-angiogenic properties, contributing to its potential therapeutic applications.
